dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Irregular, jagged light-colored perimeters forming closed 'O' and open 'C' shapes with sharp pixel-level transitions from high-intensity borders to dark interiors.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of solid high-intensity white pixel clusters concentrated along the dorsal ridge and scattered throughout the mid-lateral reticulation.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three largest lateral annuli form a scalene triangle, while smaller high-intensity clusters near the pelvic region form a roughly linear diagonal alignment.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized reddish circular anomaly visible on the right cranial region posterior to the eye.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive reticulated network of high-contrast lineaments connecting macro-annuli, creating a honeycomb-like topological structure across the flank.
